        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        List<Integer> cuts = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) even++;
            else odd++;
            if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                cuts.add(i + 1);
                even = odd = 0;
            }
        }
        
        int count = 0;

                bitcoin[i] = Math.abs(diff);
            }
            Arrays.sort(bitcoin);
            if (bitcoin[0] <= b) {
                for (int i = 0; i < cuts.size(); i++) {
                    if (i > 0) bitcoin[i] += bitcoin[i - 1];
                    if (bitcoin[i] > b) {
                        count = i;
                        break;
                    } else {
                        count = i + 1;
                    }
                }
            }

            int diff = arr[cuts.get(0)] - arr[cuts.get(0) - 1];
            if (Math.abs(diff) <= b) count = 1;
        }
        
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
